title: Build a Coop Brain
learning_outcomes: A rule has a trigger (WHEN), a condition (IF) and an action (DO)

instruction_layers.advanced: Trigger: light below 40 lux for 5 minutes (a light sensor), or a clock time.
instruction_layers.teacher: Ask: what else could be a WHEN? (a time, a button, a sensor)

steps.instruction: Require the chickens to be inside.

instruction_layers.young: IF: all the chickens are inside.
instruction_layers.beginner: Require the chickens to be inside.
instruction_layers.advanced: Condition: headcount inside equals flock size (door RFID count).
instruction_layers.teacher: Ask: what happens if one hen is still out?

instruction_layers.advanced: Action: door controller closes; the limit switch confirms closed.
instruction_layers.teacher: Ask: how would you know the door really closed?

steps.instruction: Run sunset in the simulator and watch the rule decide.

instruction_layers.young: Press the button and watch your rule work!
instruction_layers.beginner: Run sunset in the simulator and watch the rule decide.
instruction_layers.advanced: The sunset scenario evaluates trigger → condition → action and logs the chain.
instruction_layers.teacher: Then run "Hen missing at dusk": what changes?

steps.instruction: WHEN + IF + DO made one rule.

instruction_layers.beginner: WHEN + IF + DO made one rule.
instruction_layers.advanced: One automation = trigger + condition + action, with a confirmed result.
instruction_layers.teacher: Assessment: the learner writes their own WHEN / IF / DO rule.
